 Day 22: Calix at Ethan, unang Kapamilya at Kapuso evictee sa 'PBB Collab 3.0'
 Liezel Dela Cruz
 Published November 14, 2026 08:25 PM PHT 
  | 
 Updated November 15, 2026 10:24 AM PHT 
 It was a bittersweet Saturday night for “ Pinoy Big Brother Collab 3.0 ” as the season held its first eviction on November 14. Ethan Benares from the Kapuso side and Calix Esguerra from the Kapamilya bracket were the first two housemates to wrap up their "PBB" stint.
 For the Kapamilya nominees, Nathan Garcia led the votes to save with 54.6%, followed by Primo Alterado with 43.8%, while Calix received 1.6%. 
 The Kapuso tally was much closer, with Mikee Quintos coming out on top at 40.7% and Nicole Fortuna taking second place with 30.6%. Ethan finished just behind Nicole at 28.7%, making him the first Kapuso to leave Bahay Ni Kuya. 
 The evicted housemates were welcomed back with love by their families and supporters as they looked forward to brighter opportunities in the outside world. Before eviction night, the two also got to spend some sweet bonding time with their fellow housemates and say a proper goodbye alongside the other nominees through a mini-program.  
 ADVERTISEMENT
 Calix, the 'Rampanalong Apo ng Pampanga,' got sentimental in front of his friends, saying he's grateful for the lessons he'd picked up during his stay, from doing chores to treating others with respect and learning from his mistakes, and for the new family he’s found. 
 As for Ethan, the 'Sporty Palangga ng Bacolod,' he told the group, “We've shared a lot, guys. We've cried, we've laughed a lot. Honestly, I'll forever have this as my core memory and I'm really glad it was you, guys.” 
 Catch " PBB Collab 3.0 ," with episodes available on the ABS-CBN Entertainment YouTube channel, weeknights at 9:35 p.m., Saturdays at 6:15 p.m., and Sundays at 4:55 p.m. The show is also streaming for free on iWant (PH only).
